nxVersionNote: Both sessions reported keyVerified/connected for account sjj0507@midasit.com (gen and civil), but the products' build strings were not recorded - verify_connection() does not carry one. Re-stamp on a session where the build is read from the product rather than inferring it.
why: Every endpoint here is a /db/* resource whose manual section leaves its request ambiguous in a way that blocks a contract: a key cell naming more than one wire property, a duplicate key, a variant table with no stated resolution, or a schema root the table never mentions. /info is the server's own answer and a permitted contract source. Captured verbatim; no GET response body is included, so nothing here is model data.
